title: Bilinear nonzero probability identity
statement: Let $D$ be an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$. For independent uniformly distributed vectors $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the probability that $x\cdot(Dy)$ is nonzero equals one half the probability that $Dy$ is nonzero for a uniformly distributed $y\in\mathbb F_2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$
